projects.title: AI-powered POS system
projects.description: Developed a full-stack AI-powered POS system with cashier checkout, inventory management, sales analytics, receipt generation, multi-payment support, role-based access control, and English/Sinhala support. Implemented real-time stock alerts using SSE, automated inventory updates with PostgreSQL transactions, and AI-powered business recommendations using Hugging Face and Gemini APIs.
